Undersupply#000.src: Investigate the river settlement's water troubles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#000.dst: Investiga los problemas de agua del poblado del río en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#001.src: Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
Undersupply#001.dst: ¡Ojo, hacía lunas que no veía un atuendo así! Eres de esa gente de {p}, ¿a que sí? Menudos lujos habrás tenido.
Undersupply#001.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#002.src: 's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
Undersupply#002.dst: Aquí abajo, a la sombra de la presa, todo es más humilde. Me extraña que alguien como tú haga el viaje, pero no me quejo. ¡Recorrer el mundo es una buena empresa!
Undersupply#002.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#003.src: Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
Undersupply#003.dst: Por desgracia, el bar está seco. Alcohol tengo, pero si lo bebes, echarás más agua de la que metes. Te deja seco, y ahora mismo no nos sobra ni una gota. Es peligroso, ¿sabes?
Undersupply#003.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#004.src: The dam opens up every month or so to let out some water for us, but is passes through a noble manor, past the hill, rationed out to the rest of the forest.
Undersupply#004.dst: La presa se abre cada mes más o menos para soltarnos algo de agua, pero pasa por una mansión noble tras la colina y la reparten al resto del bosque.
Undersupply#004.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#005.src: It's so little though, nowadays. The children are going thirsty. The muck in the riverbeds is more mud than water- so even if ya boil it out like I do, what you get is foul trifles.
Undersupply#005.dst: Pero hoy en día es tan poca... Los niños pasan sed. Los cauces tienen más barro que agua: aunque la hiervas, como hago yo, lo que sale es una porquería.
Undersupply#005.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#006.src: Didn't used to be like this, though. Ain't sure what's changed, but I'm just an old geezer. I've lived my life enough- it's what it's doing to the kids that has me worried. ...say, stranger.
Undersupply#006.dst: Antes no era así, ¿eh? No sé qué ha cambiado, pero solo soy un viejo cascarrabias. Yo ya he vivido bastante; lo que me preocupa es lo que les hace a los críos. ...oye, forastero.
Undersupply#006.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#007.src: If you're touring about here, you'll probably see the manor soon enough. If ya could get them to spare us some more water a while, I'll give ya a discount! How's about it?
Undersupply#007.dst: Si andas de visita por aquí, pronto verás la mansión. Si consigues que nos den algo más de agua durante un tiempo, ¡te haré un descuento! ¿Qué me dices?
Undersupply#007.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#008.src: Ain't quite sure how you would go about convincing the nobles to let out more water for us, I admit. If I did, I'd take the trek up the hill myself- even in spite of my creaky ol' back.
Undersupply#008.dst: No sé muy bien cómo convencerías a los nobles para que nos suelten más agua, lo admito. Si lo supiera, subiría yo mismo la colina, aunque me cruja la espalda.
Undersupply#008.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#009.src: Even if it's just getting them to put a word in to the Sovereign. I imagine that come-lately Zhiraok would do something about it all. I swear that man doesn't know what sleep is...
Undersupply#009.dst: Aunque solo sea que hablen con el Soberano. Me imagino que ese recién llegado de Zhiraok haría algo al respecto. Te juro que ese hombre no sabe lo que es dormir...
Undersupply#009.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#010.src: I can appreciate a young'un with some spark in their eyes, but he needs to learn to slow down! What's that saying about the brightest candle burning twice as fast?
Undersupply#010.dst: Me gustan los jóvenes con chispa en los ojos, ¡pero tiene que frenar un poco! ¿Cómo era eso de que la vela que más brilla se consume el doble de rápido?
Undersupply#010.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#011.src: Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
Undersupply#011.dst: ¡Ay, madre! ¿Quién es usted? ¡Con un equipo tan fantástico! No es un guardia, desde luego: ¡nunca había visto algo así! Ay, ay, ay...
Undersupply#011.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#012.src: Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
Undersupply#012.dst: A no ser que... ¿Será usted...? El viento susurra que hay un nuevo Soberano. Nuestro Soberano viste de otra manera, así que quizá-
Undersupply#012.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#013.src: No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
Undersupply#013.dst: ¿No? ¿No lo es? ¡Hm! Bueno, sea como sea, ojalá pudiera recibirle con más hospitalidad, forastero, pero estamos en la época escasa del mes, la más escasa que he visto.
Undersupply#013.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#014.src: *cough* Oh dear, excuse me. My throat is simply so dry... My children need the water more than I, but I would darn a dozen robes for but a glass now.
Undersupply#014.dst: *cof* Ay, disculpe. Tengo la garganta tan seca... Mis hijos necesitan el agua más que yo, pero ahora zurciría una docena de túnicas por un vaso.
Undersupply#014.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#015.src: The dam opens every month or so- I assume you wouldn't know, stranger. The water is rationed to us by the nobles in a manor over the hill.
Undersupply#015.dst: La presa se abre cada mes más o menos; supongo que usted no lo sabe, forastero. Los nobles de la mansión tras la colina nos racionan el agua.
Undersupply#015.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#016.src: This time of year is usually dry, but the amount of water we have received lately has been less and less. I wonder what is happening...
Undersupply#016.dst: En esta época del año suele hacer seco, pero el agua que nos llega es cada vez menos. Me pregunto qué pasará...
Undersupply#016.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#017.src: This kind lumberer has been visiting and passing out bottles, and without him I am certain my children wouldn't have made it. I'm unsure how much longer I can keep my family healthy...
Undersupply#017.dst: Un leñador muy amable viene a repartir botellas, y sin él estoy segura de que mis hijos no lo habrían superado. No sé cuánto más podré mantener sana a mi familia...
Undersupply#017.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#018.src: Oh, if only those nobles could spare more for us... Perhaps I could speak with them- but then, who would watch over my children here?
Undersupply#018.dst: Ay, si esos nobles pudieran darnos algo más... Quizá podría hablar con ellos, pero entonces, ¿quién cuidaría de mis hijos?
Undersupply#018.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#019.src: So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger.
Undersupply#019.dst: Así que... por mucho que quisiera recibirle con una comida y una taza de té caliente... simplemente no puedo. Lo siento muchísimo, forastero.
Undersupply#019.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#020.src: I beg your pardon for it. I cannot spare the hospitality. Even my gardens I've had to abandon... My great-grandmother's flowers have wilted.
Undersupply#020.dst: Le ruego que me perdone. No puedo permitirme ser hospitalaria. Hasta el jardín he tenido que abandonar... Las flores de mi bisabuela se han marchitado.
Undersupply#020.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#021.src: My son had the idea to press the flowers so they would not be gone forever...But as it is, the risk of losing the rest of my family for the drought... I can't bear it!
Undersupply#021.dst: A mi hijo se le ocurrió prensar las flores para que no se perdieran para siempre... Pero tal como están las cosas, arriesgarme a perder al resto de mi familia por la sequía... ¡No lo soporto!
Undersupply#021.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#022.src: ...it may be rude to ask, but...could you ask the nobles of the manor, perhaps? To spare a drop or two extra? I'd be forever indebted to you...
Undersupply#022.dst: ...quizá sea grosero pedirlo, pero... ¿podría hablar con los nobles de la mansión? ¿Que nos den una gota o dos más? Le estaría siempre en deuda...
Undersupply#022.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#023.src: Whoa. That is positively outlandish dress. You...couldn't be a crown guard, can you be? That's simply so far out of uniform...so are you from the {p}, maybe?
Undersupply#023.dst: Vaya. Qué atuendo tan estrafalario. Usted... no será un guardia de la Corona, ¿verdad? Eso no se parece al uniforme... ¿Viene de {p}, quizá?
Undersupply#023.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#024.src: But then, why would you be here? The Festival...isn't that soon over in {p}? Why come all the way over here? I've hardly anything to trade, even.
Undersupply#024.dst: Pero entonces, ¿qué hace aquí? El Festival... ¿no es pronto en {p}? ¿Para qué venir hasta aquí? Si apenas tengo nada que vender.
Undersupply#024.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#025.src: It's the dry season, you know. End of the month, I'm sure you- ehm, wait. Perhaps, since you live atop the dam, that isn't the case? Oh, what I would do for that luxury!
Undersupply#025.dst: Es la estación seca, ¿sabe? Fin de mes, seguro que usted... ehm, un momento. Quizá, viviendo encima de la presa, ¿no le pase? ¡Ay, lo que daría yo por ese lujo!
Undersupply#025.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#026.src: Well, to the point- I've nothing to sell but dry herbs. A sad state for our village, when the apothecary cannot even make medicine, but every bit of water has to go towards necessities.
Undersupply#026.dst: En fin, al grano: no tengo nada que vender salvo hierbas secas. Triste situación para el pueblo, que el boticario no pueda hacer medicinas, pero cada gota va a lo imprescindible.
Undersupply#026.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#027.src: We've been receiving less and less. Some generous folks have been sharing, but that does only so far. A glass here and there cannot revitalize my poor garden.
Undersupply#027.dst: Cada vez recibimos menos. Hay gente generosa que comparte, pero eso no llega muy lejos. Un vaso aquí y otro allá no reviven mi pobre jardín.
Undersupply#027.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#028.src: If you want to find something more suited to the luxuries you might be used to, perhaps visit the manor over the hill? They do ration out the water to us, as well.
Undersupply#028.dst: Si busca algo más acorde con los lujos que conoce, ¿por qué no visita la mansión tras la colina? Ellos también nos racionan el agua.
Undersupply#028.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#029.src: ...far be it from me to make demands of a visitor, but... Should you visit, could you put in a word with them? A kindness begets a kindness, after all.
Undersupply#029.dst: ...lejos de mí exigirle nada a un visitante, pero... si va a visitarlos, ¿podría hablar con ellos? Al fin y al cabo, favor con favor se paga.
Undersupply#029.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#030.src: I've lived here all my life, I have. And I've always been learned to make everything stretch, to be diligent and frugal, but with things as they are, those skills fail me.
Undersupply#030.dst: He vivido aquí toda mi vida, sí. Siempre me enseñaron a estirar las cosas, a ser diligente y ahorrador, pero tal como están las cosas, esas habilidades no me sirven.
Undersupply#030.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#031.src: People could fall ill without my services, could die, and I would hate to see our families broken apart, but I may have no choice but to leave if this keeps up.
Undersupply#031.dst: Sin mí la gente podría enfermar, incluso morir, y odiaría ver familias rotas, pero si esto sigue así quizá no me quede otra que irme.
Undersupply#031.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#032.src: Oh, but I'm sure a sightseer like yourself doesn't want to hear the qualms of a man such as myself. Do enjoy the sights of our humble forest, would you?
Undersupply#032.dst: Ay, pero seguro que a un turista como usted no le interesan las penas de un hombre como yo. Disfrute de las vistas de nuestro humilde bosque, ¿quiere?
Undersupply#032.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#033.src: Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
Undersupply#033.dst: ¡Ojo, hacía lunas que no veía un atuendo así! Eres de esa gente de {p}, ¿a que sí? Menudos lujos habrás tenido.
Undersupply#033.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#034.src: 's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
Undersupply#034.dst: Aquí abajo, a la sombra de la presa, todo es más humilde. Me extraña que alguien como tú haga el viaje, pero no me quejo. ¡Recorrer el mundo es una buena empresa!
Undersupply#034.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#035.src: Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
Undersupply#035.dst: Por desgracia, el bar está seco. Alcohol tengo, pero si lo bebes, echarás más agua de la que metes. Te deja seco, y ahora mismo no nos sobra ni una gota. Es peligroso, ¿sabes?
Undersupply#035.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#036.src: With the manor over the hill there barely letting out water for us anymore, it's all getting so much tougher. Kills me to see the children struggling like this...
Undersupply#036.dst: Con la mansión de tras la colina apenas soltándonos agua, todo se pone mucho más difícil. Me mata ver a los críos pasarlo tan mal...
Undersupply#036.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#037.src: Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
Undersupply#037.dst: ¡Ay, madre! ¿Quién es usted? ¡Con un equipo tan fantástico! No es un guardia, desde luego: ¡nunca había visto algo así! Ay, ay, ay...
Undersupply#037.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#038.src: Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
Undersupply#038.dst: A no ser que... ¿Será usted...? El viento susurra que hay un nuevo Soberano. Nuestro Soberano viste de otra manera, así que quizá-
Undersupply#038.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#039.src: No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
Undersupply#039.dst: ¿No? ¿No lo es? ¡Hm! Bueno, sea como sea, ojalá pudiera recibirle con más hospitalidad, forastero, pero estamos en la época escasa del mes, la más escasa que he visto.
Undersupply#039.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#040.src: So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger- there is barely enough water for my own family to drink.
Undersupply#040.dst: Así que... por mucho que quisiera recibirle con una comida y una taza de té caliente... no puedo. Lo siento muchísimo, forastero: apenas hay agua para que beba mi familia.
Undersupply#040.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#041.src: Oh, if only those nobles could spare more for us... Perhaps I could speak with them- but then, who would watch over my children here?
Undersupply#041.dst: Ay, si esos nobles pudieran darnos algo más... Quizá podría hablar con ellos, pero entonces, ¿quién cuidaría de mis hijos?
Undersupply#041.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#042.src: Whoa. That is positively outlandish dress. You...couldn't be a crown guard, can you be? That's simply so far out of uniform...so are you from the {p}, maybe?
Undersupply#042.dst: Vaya. Qué atuendo tan estrafalario. Usted... no será un guardia de la Corona, ¿verdad? Eso no se parece al uniforme... ¿Viene de {p}, quizá?
Undersupply#042.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#043.src: But then, why would you be here? The Festival...isn't that soon over in {p}? Why come all the way over here? I've hardly anything to trade, even.
Undersupply#043.dst: Pero entonces, ¿qué hace aquí? El Festival... ¿no es pronto en {p}? ¿Para qué venir hasta aquí? Si apenas tengo nada que vender.
Undersupply#043.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#044.src: It's the dry season, you know. End of the month, I'm sure you- ehm, wait. Perhaps, since you live atop the dam, that isn't the case? Oh, what I would do for that luxury!
Undersupply#044.dst: Es la estación seca, ¿sabe? Fin de mes, seguro que usted... ehm, un momento. Quizá, viviendo encima de la presa, ¿no le pase? ¡Ay, lo que daría yo por ese lujo!
Undersupply#044.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#045.src: Either way... It is difficult here. Perhaps I ought petition the Sovereeign to increase the rations. I'm sure he would listen, given how much he has helped in the past twenty years, or so.
Undersupply#045.dst: Sea como sea... Aquí las cosas están difíciles. Quizá debería pedir al Soberano que aumente las raciones. Seguro que escucharía, con lo mucho que ha ayudado en estos veinte años.
Undersupply#045.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#046.src: Hrm. Can't even wash my clothes with the streams this claggy and slow... What a dilemma.
Undersupply#046.dst: Hrm. Ni siquiera puedo lavar la ropa con los arroyos tan turbios y lentos... Qué dilema.
Undersupply#046.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#047.src: I'm telling you, the guards in the dam are putting something in the water to turn the frogs gigantic!
Undersupply#047.dst: ¡Te lo digo yo: los guardias de la presa le echan algo al agua para que las ranas se vuelvan gigantes!
Undersupply#047.speaker: Doyel

Undersupply#048.src: I've seen one with my own eyes, wandering about! Soon enough they'll send them to eat us!
Undersupply#048.dst: ¡He visto una con mis propios ojos, rondando por aquí! ¡Pronto las mandarán a comernos!
Undersupply#048.speaker: Doyel

Undersupply#049.src: What? Selling the house? What do you- Oh, that!
Undersupply#049.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#050.src: No, no, a salesman sold me a 'For Sale' sign, in case I wanted to sell something. I wasn't sure where else to put it, is all.
Undersupply#050.dst: No, no, un vendedor me vendió un cartel de «Se vende», por si quería vender algo. Es que no sabía dónde más ponerlo, nada más.
Undersupply#050.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#051.src: It's dry enough here that I have considered it, though...
Undersupply#051.dst: Aunque aquí está todo tan seco que me lo he planteado...
Undersupply#051.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#052.src: Make your way to the manor and question them. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#052.dst: Ve a la mansión y pregunta a sus dueños. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#053.src: Welcome to the manor. Have the townspeople sent you?
Undersupply#053.dst: Le doy la bienvenida a la mansión. ¿Le envía la gente del pueblo?
Undersupply#053.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#054.src: As I had expected. In that case, let me walk you to the masters.
Undersupply#054.dst: Lo que me esperaba. En ese caso, le acompañaré ante los señores.
Undersupply#054.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#055.src: Still- allow me to lead you to the masters.
Undersupply#055.dst: Aun así, permítame llevarle ante los señores.
Undersupply#055.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#056.src: Ah, haha! Hayn, who might this be? Ostentatious dress, I must declare! Is this a tourist come to tour the manor, mayhaps?
Undersupply#056.dst: ¡Ah, jaja! Hayn, ¿a quién tenemos aquí? ¡Un atuendo ostentoso, he de declarar! ¿Será acaso un turista que viene a visitar la mansión?
Undersupply#056.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#057.src: Ohh... I see! The locals sent you. Then, allow me to enlighten you on the matter. You see, the Crown has entrusted us to manage the water supplied from the dam.
Undersupply#057.dst: Ooh... ¡Ya veo! Le envían los lugareños. Entonces, permítame que le ilustre. Verá, la Corona nos ha confiado gestionar el agua que sale de la presa.
Undersupply#057.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#058.src: All potable water in the forest comes through us- it is our responsibility to ensure the rations we are given are spread to where it is most needed.
Undersupply#058.dst: Toda el agua potable del bosque pasa por nosotros: es nuestra responsabilidad que las raciones lleguen a donde más se necesitan.
Undersupply#058.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#059.src: With the Crown Festival in {p} being about this time, the water must go there! Additionally, with all the new construction recently, there have been more places to ration out to.
Undersupply#059.dst: Con el Festival de la Corona en {p} por estas fechas, ¡el agua tiene que ir allí! Además, con tanta construcción nueva, hay más sitios entre los que repartirla.
Undersupply#059.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#060.src: We, too, have taken a smaller share than normal. The village down there, unfortunately, has been the lowest priority for some months now. I have petitioned the Sovereign for more water...
Undersupply#060.dst: Nosotros también nos quedamos con menos de lo normal. El pueblo de abajo, por desgracia, lleva meses siendo la última prioridad. He pedido al Soberano más agua...
Undersupply#060.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#061.src: ...but that will not solve the problem here and now. Neither would a gulp here, or a bottle there. It does break my heart, it truly does! But we must take our responsibilities seriously.
Undersupply#061.dst: ...pero eso no resuelve el problema aquí y ahora. Tampoco un trago aquí o una botella allá. ¡Me parte el corazón, de verdad! Pero debemos tomarnos en serio nuestras responsabilidades.
Undersupply#061.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#062.src: ...Hm. Hm, hm, hm... But perhaps...what if...
Undersupply#062.dst: ...Hm. Hm, hm, hm... Pero quizá... ¿y si...?
Undersupply#062.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#063.src: Oh, do speak up! I hear you turning over an idea in your head, good Sir!
Undersupply#063.dst: ¡Ah, hable, hable! ¡Le oigo darle vueltas a una idea, buen señor!
Undersupply#063.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#064.src: Well, perhaps it is a foolish thought. But, if they were to tinker with the dam's systems and let out more water for all of us earlier than the next month? Tide us over 'til the Nasin gets his head on straight?
Undersupply#064.dst: Bueno, quizá sea una idea tonta. Pero ¿y si alguien manipulara la presa y soltara más agua para todos antes del mes que viene? ¿Aguantar hasta que el Nasin siente la cabeza?
Undersupply#064.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#065.src: Hm! Foolish indeed! Quite unlike you, I must say- only us and the highest ranks of the military have access to the dam! Why, we would be suspects number one, two, and three!
Undersupply#065.dst: ¡Hm! ¡Tonta, sin duda! Nada propio de usted, he de decir: ¡solo nosotros y los altos mandos del ejército tenemos acceso a la presa! ¡Seríamos los sospechosos uno, dos y tres!
Undersupply#065.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#066.src: And what if we were to...have some scofflaw break into the mansion, and lift the key, good Master? Why, we would be helpless bystanders, free of responsibility and suspicion.
Undersupply#066.dst: ¿Y si... algún maleante entrara en la mansión y se llevara la llave, buen señor? Vaya, seríamos simples testigos indefensos, libres de culpa y sospecha.
Undersupply#066.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#067.src: ...you mean, to have this traveler pose as a thief, and steal the key to the dam?
Undersupply#067.dst: ...¿quiere decir que este viajero se haga pasar por ladrón y robe la llave de la presa?
Undersupply#067.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#068.src: Hahaha!! There is wisdom I have known from you for so long! What a magnificient idea! It would not be without risk for you, traveler, but we all stand to gain!
Undersupply#068.dst: ¡¡Jajaja!! ¡Esa es la sabiduría que le conozco desde hace tanto! ¡Qué idea tan magnífica! No será sin riesgo para usted, viajero, ¡pero todos saldremos ganando!
Undersupply#068.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#069.src: The dam is guarded heavily, and assuredly the Crown's military would pursue you...but if you were to succeed, we could have more than enough water 'til the Sovereign receives our petition!
Undersupply#069.dst: La presa está muy vigilada, y seguro que el ejército de la Corona le perseguiría... pero si lo logra, ¡tendríamos agua de sobra hasta que el Soberano reciba nuestra petición!
Undersupply#069.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#070.src: That being said, should you take it upon yourself to do this, we must pretend to have never met! To keep suspicion away from us, you know. Still, our gratitude will abound!
Undersupply#070.dst: Dicho esto, si decide hacerlo, ¡debemos fingir que nunca nos conocimos! Para alejar las sospechas, ya sabe. Aun así, ¡nuestra gratitud será inmensa!
Undersupply#070.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#071.src: Hayn! Please bring the stranger to the rose, under which we have hidden the key. And good tidings to you!
Undersupply#071.dst: ¡Hayn! Lleve al forastero hasta la rosa bajo la que escondimos la llave. ¡Y buena suerte!
Undersupply#071.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#072.src: Take the key to the dam from under the rose. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#072.dst: Coge la llave de la presa de debajo de la rosa. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#073.src: Now, away with you, 'scofflaw!' Ah, haha! I shall be looking forward to sharing a veritable tidal wave of water with the forest!
Undersupply#073.dst: ¡Y ahora fuera de aquí, «maleante»! ¡Ah, jaja! ¡Estoy deseando compartir con el bosque un verdadero maremoto de agua!
Undersupply#073.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#074.src: We shall call for the guards only after you are well out of sight. Be sure to leave a scene- it may delay them for longer.
Undersupply#074.dst: Llamaremos a los guardias solo cuando esté bien lejos. Asegúrese de dejar un buen desorden: puede retrasarlos más.
Undersupply#074.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#075.src: Do make a mess, please. The masters will want a convincing scene.
Undersupply#075.dst: Haga un buen desorden, por favor. Los señores querrán una escena convincente.
Undersupply#075.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#076.src: If you've taken the key, take it to the entrance east of here.
Undersupply#076.dst: Si ya tiene la llave, llévela a la entrada al este de aquí.
Undersupply#076.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#077.src: Enter the Fruma Dam and find a way to make the water flow. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#077.dst: Entra en la presa de Fruma y busca la forma de que el agua fluya. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#078.src: Hm... Then, once you have entered the dam, you should avoid returning here. I would hate to see you escape, but be caught returning to the scene of the crime.
Undersupply#078.dst: Hm... Entonces, una vez que entre en la presa, no vuelva por aquí. Sería una pena que escapara y le atraparan al volver a la escena del crimen.
Undersupply#078.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#079.src: So this is the scene of the robbery, then. And you say they took the key to the dam?
Undersupply#079.dst: Así que esta es la escena del robo. ¿Y dice que se llevaron la llave de la presa?
Undersupply#079.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#081.src: This room is too open to guard effectively. Reverse psychology doesn't work on thieves- they'll check the obvious spots to cover their bases.
Undersupply#081.dst: Esta sala es demasiado abierta para vigilarla bien. La psicología inversa no funciona con ladrones: miran en los sitios obvios por si acaso.
Undersupply#081.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#082.src: By this point...they likely will have gone into the dam. I'll have to mobilize the forces and deal with them.
Undersupply#082.dst: A estas alturas... seguramente ya habrán entrado en la presa. Tendré que movilizar a las tropas y ocuparme.
Undersupply#082.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#083.src: I'll be reporting this. You'll get a replacement key, but lose it again and you'll be relieved of your responsibilities. Consider this your one chance.
Undersupply#083.dst: Informaré de esto. Recibirán una llave de repuesto, pero si la vuelven a perder, les relevarán de sus funciones. Considérenlo su única oportunidad.
Undersupply#083.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#085.src: So this was your plan! Here to sabotage the game... trying to steal water for yourself? Or did you mean to bring destruction? Cause a flood?
Undersupply#085.dst: ¡Así que este era tu plan! Venir a sabotear... ¿Robar agua para ti? ¿O querías sembrar la destrucción? ¿Provocar una inundación?
Undersupply#085.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#086.src: I'll not be letting you get away with such heinous crimes. Lay down your weapons!
Undersupply#086.dst: No voy a dejar que te salgas con la tuya con crímenes tan atroces. ¡Suelta las armas!
Undersupply#086.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#087.src: Return to the settlement and tell them about your success. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#087.dst: Vuelve al poblado y cuéntales tu éxito. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#088.src: The water seems to be flowing! Isn't it too early this month? I have to get back and tell the others.
Undersupply#088.dst: ¡Parece que el agua fluye! ¿No es muy pronto este mes? Tengo que volver y avisar a los demás.
Undersupply#088.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#089.src: Wonderful, wonderful! I've sent Hayn with your payment to the village. Now hurry, hurry, 'scofflaw!' You wouldn't want to be caught, after all that trouble!
Undersupply#089.dst: ¡Maravilloso, maravilloso! He enviado a Hayn al pueblo con su pago. ¡Y ahora deprisa, deprisa, «maleante»! ¡No querrá que le atrapen después de tanto esfuerzo!
Undersupply#089.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#090.src: Hm! You'd best be going, else the guards may catch you. Our butler has gone away to the village with a dividend of payment. Do hurry there, would you?
Undersupply#090.dst: ¡Hm! Más vale que se vaya, o los guardias podrían atraparle. Nuestro mayordomo ha ido al pueblo con una parte del pago. Dese prisa en ir allí, ¿quiere?
Undersupply#090.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#091.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#091.dst: ¡Dios... Dios mío! ¡El pozo! ¡Todos, el pozo se está llenando! ¡Mis hijos... tendrán agua!
Undersupply#091.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#092.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... But I will not complain of good fortune!
Undersupply#092.dst: ¡El río también fluye! Desde luego, aún no toca otra ración este mes... ¡Pero no me quejaré de la buena suerte!
Undersupply#092.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#093.src: Seems like the stranger with that spark in their eyes did it! Have to give 'em that discount I mentioned. I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is.
Undersupply#093.dst: ¡Parece que el forastero con chispa en los ojos lo ha logrado! Tendré que hacerle ese descuento que dije. ¡Podré volver a abrir el bar como es debido! Qué buen día.
Undersupply#093.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#094.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! Was this... That strange fellow in the Sovereign-like dress... Did they...?! They must have!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#094.dst: ¡Dios... Dios mío! ¡El pozo! ¡Todos, el pozo se está llenando! ¿Ha sido... ese extraño forastero con ropa de Soberano...? ¡Seguro que sí! ¡Mis hijos... tendrán agua!
Undersupply#094.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#095.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... But I will not complain of good fortune!
Undersupply#095.dst: ¡El río también fluye! Desde luego, aún no toca otra ración este mes... ¡Pero no me quejaré de la buena suerte!
Undersupply#095.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#096.src: I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
Undersupply#096.dst: ¡Podré volver a abrir el bar como es debido! Qué buen día. Oye, forastero...
Undersupply#096.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#097.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#097.dst: ¡Dios... Dios mío! ¡El pozo! ¡Todos, el pozo se está llenando! ¡Mis hijos... tendrán agua!
Undersupply#097.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#098.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... Oh! It must have been that tourist! Perhaps they asked the manor to release some extra?
Undersupply#098.dst: ¡El río también fluye! Aún no toca otra ración este mes... ¡Oh! ¡Seguro que fue ese turista! ¿Quizá pidió a la mansión que soltaran algo más?
Undersupply#098.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#099.src: I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
Undersupply#099.dst: ¡Podré volver a abrir el bar como es debido! Qué buen día. Oye, forastero...
Undersupply#099.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#100.src: So then! I have to figure this was you! Got the manor to let out a little extra, did you?
Undersupply#100.dst: ¡Vaya, vaya! ¡Me da que esto ha sido cosa tuya! Conseguiste que la mansión soltara algo más, ¿eh?
Undersupply#100.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#101.src: They have risked life and limb to enter the dam and allow the water to flow freely. Show your thanks, and do not report them.
Undersupply#101.dst: Ha arriesgado la vida para entrar en la presa y dejar que el agua fluya libremente. Denle las gracias y no le denuncien.
Undersupply#101.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#102.src: The masters have sent me to hand out compensation for your dangerous actions.
Undersupply#102.dst: Los señores me envían a repartir una compensación por sus peligrosos actos.
Undersupply#102.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#103.src: Wait, the ro- Why did you jump off th- The masters, wh- Are you from the manor?! Why did-
Undersupply#103.dst: Espere, el te- ¿Por qué ha saltado del te-? Los señores, qu- ¿Es usted de la mansión? ¿Por qué-
Undersupply#103.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#104.src: There was no more water for the masters to give. They have fixed the problem for all of us.
Undersupply#104.dst: Los señores ya no tenían más agua que dar. Han resuelto el problema para todos.
Undersupply#104.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#105.src: Even you were short? Gracious. Still...our gardens may now grow, our children may now drink... We can only give you our utmost thanks, stranger!
Undersupply#105.dst: ¿Ni ustedes tenían bastante? Madre mía. Aun así... crecerán los jardines, beberán los niños... ¡Solo podemos darle las gracias de corazón, forastero!
Undersupply#105.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#106.src: Thank ye traveler. I gotta get myself back to the bar. See ye around and stay safe!
Undersupply#106.dst: Gracias, viajero. Tengo que volver al bar. ¡Nos vemos, y cuídate!
Undersupply#106.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#107.src: Did the butler just jump off the roof!? W-whatever, I have to get home! Thank you!
Undersupply#107.dst: ¿¡El mayordomo acaba de saltar del tejado!? B-bueno, ¡tengo que irme a casa! ¡Gracias!
Undersupply#107.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#108.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#108.dst: El agua también le hace falta a la mansión, ¿eh? Qué se le va a hacer, al menos la reparten por todo el bosque.
Undersupply#108.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#109.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#109.dst: Son unos negociantes muy listos, entiendo el trajín. ¡Quizá pronto les pida algún consejo!
Undersupply#109.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#110.src: I must be going now. The guards won't forgive you for slaying Balsura, but hopefully you can keep from being caught. Good luck.
Undersupply#110.dst: Debo irme ya. Los guardias no le perdonarán que matara a Balsura, pero ojalá consiga que no le atrapen. Buena suerte.
Undersupply#110.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#111.src: Hey traveler, remember my promise? Discounted water for life! What do ye say? Want some?
Undersupply#111.dst: Oye, viajero, ¿recuerdas mi promesa? ¡Agua con descuento de por vida! ¿Qué me dices? ¿Quieres?
Undersupply#111.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#113.src: Pleasure doing business with ye! Jokes aside, thanks for all you've done.
Undersupply#113.dst: ¡Un placer hacer negocios contigo! Bromas aparte, gracias por todo.
Undersupply#113.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#114.src: Guh, you must be pulling my leg...! ...Thanks for all you've done, traveler.
Undersupply#114.dst: Uf, ¡me estás tomando el pelo...! ...Gracias por todo, viajero.
Undersupply#114.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#115.src: Hey traveler, good work out there. Whenever the heat's off ye, come visit me!
Undersupply#115.dst: Oye, viajero, buen trabajo. ¡Cuando dejen de buscarte, ven a verme!
Undersupply#115.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#116.src: You're still around, traveler! Stay safe, please! I don't know what I would do if you were caught!
Undersupply#116.dst: ¡Sigue por aquí, viajero! ¡Cuídese, por favor! ¡No sé qué haría si le atraparan!
Undersupply#116.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#117.src: Although, if you ever need some water, feel free to stop by!
Undersupply#117.dst: Aunque, si alguna vez necesita agua, ¡pase cuando quiera!
Undersupply#117.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#118.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#118.dst: El agua también le hace falta a la mansión, ¿eh? Qué se le va a hacer, al menos la reparten por todo el bosque.
Undersupply#118.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#119.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#119.dst: Son unos negociantes muy listos, entiendo el trajín. ¡Quizá pronto les pida algún consejo!
Undersupply#119.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#120.src: Hrm. I got so used to the stream being slow that I lost my last robe to the water flow. What a dilemma.
Undersupply#120.dst: Hrm. Me acostumbré tanto a que el arroyo fuera lento que la corriente se llevó mi última túnica. Qué dilema.
Undersupply#120.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#121.src: I really ought to put away that 'For Sale' sign so no one else gets confused...
Undersupply#121.dst: Debería quitar ese cartel de «Se vende» para que nadie más se confunda...
Undersupply#121.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#122.src: Fine work, indeed! I might welcome you with a cup of tea, but I cannot abide by 'scofflaws' such as yourself- wink, wink! Now away with you! Ah, haha!
Undersupply#122.dst: ¡Un trabajo espléndido, sin duda! Le invitaría a una taza de té, pero no tolero a «maleantes» como usted, ¡guiño, guiño! ¡Y ahora fuera de aquí! ¡Ah, jaja!
Undersupply#122.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#123.src: Hm. Hm, hm, hm... I should keep better track of the ledgers. If I had noticed earlier, petitioned earlier... But of course, a Nasin wouldn't have thought ahead... Hm...
Undersupply#123.dst: Hm. Hm, hm, hm... Debería llevar mejor las cuentas. Si lo hubiera notado antes, si hubiera pedido antes... Pero claro, un Nasin no habría previsto nada... Hm...
Undersupply#123.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#124.src: Stay out of trouble from now on. The beginning of strife is as when one lets out water.
Undersupply#124.dst: De ahora en adelante, no se meta en líos. El principio de la discordia es como quien suelta las aguas.
Undersupply#124.speaker: Butler Hayn
